title: List of Factions missions and primary quests
wikitext:
This is a list of all the [[mission]]s and primary quests in [[Guild Wars Factions]], taking you through the [[storyline]], as well as the [[challenge Mission]]s and [[Competitive Mission]]s. Characters from non-Factions campaigns who travel to [[Cantha]] will join the storyline at [[Bejunkan Pier]] with the quest [[Welcome to Cantha]].

== Storyline Missions ==
=== [[Shing Jea Island]] ===
The first quest offered to a new character is the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]]. For players already familiar with the game, you can skip the tutorial completely. Depending on the profession of your character, the chain of quests to be completed will be:

::{{w}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Zhan]] → [[Locate Talon Silverwing]] → [[Talon's Duel]] → [[Track Down Weng Gha]] → [[The Crop Thieves]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (warrior)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{r}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Greico]] → [[Locate Sujun]] → [[Free the Fur]] → [[Track Down Zho]] → [[The Yeti Hunt]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (ranger)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{mo}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Amara]] → [[Locate Sister Tai]] → [[Stale Mate]] → [[Track Down Brother Pe Wan]] → [[Seeking a Cure]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (monk)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{n}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Kuju]] → [[Locate Reng Ku]] → [[Little Creatures]] → [[Track Down Su]] → [[Reaping the Naga]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (necromancer)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{me}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Kaa]] → [[Locate Mei Ling]] → [[Cleansing the Shrine]] → [[Track Down Lo Sha]] → [[Lo Sha's Gift]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (mesmer)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{e}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Vhang]] → [[Locate Ronsu]] → [[Spark of Interest]] → [[Track Down Kai Ying]] → [[Sparring Elements]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (elementalist)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{a}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Lee]] → [[Locate Jinzo]] → [[Opening Strike]] → [[Track Down Panaku]] → [[Dual Strike]]  → [[An Audience with Master Togo (assassin)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{rt}} [[Seek Out Headmaster Quin]] → [[Locate Professor Gai]] → [[Minions Gone Wild]] → [[Track Down Ang the Ephemeral]] → [[Shackled Spirits]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (ritualist)|An Audience with Master Togo]]

If you have not yet chosen a [[Profession|secondary profession]], Master Togo will allow you to take the quest to choose one now. Depending on what secondary profession you wish to choose, the quest chain will be: 

::{{w}} [[Speak with Headmaster Zhan (Warrior)]] → [[Locate Talon Silverwing]] → [[Talon's Duel]] → [[Track Down Weng Gha]] → [[The Crop Thieves]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (warrior)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{r}} [[Speak with Headmaster Greico (Ranger)]] → [[Locate Sujun]] → [[Free the Fur]] → [[Track Down Zho]] → [[The Yeti Hunt]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (ranger)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{mo}} [[Speak with Headmaster Amara (Monk)]] → [[Locate Sister Tai]] → [[Stale Mate]] → [[Track Down Brother Pe Wan]] → [[Seeking a Cure]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (monk)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{n}} [[Speak with Headmaster Kuju (Necromancer)]] → [[Locate Reng Ku]] → [[Little Creatures]] → [[Track Down Su]] → [[Reaping the Naga]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (necromancer)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{me}} [[Speak with Headmaster Kaa (Mesmer)]] → [[Locate Mei Ling]] → [[Cleansing the Shrine]] → [[Track Down Lo Sha]] → [[Lo Sha's Gift]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (mesmer)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{e}} [[Speak with Headmaster Vhang (Elementalist)]] → [[Locate Ronsu]] → [[Spark of Interest]] → [[Track Down Kai Ying]] → [[Sparring Elements]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (elementalist)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{a}} [[Speak with Headmaster Lee (Assassin)]] → [[Locate Jinzo]] → [[Opening Strike]] → [[Track Down Panaku]] → [[Dual Strike]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (assassin)|An Audience with Master Togo]]
::{{rt}} [[Speak with Headmaster Quin (Ritualist)]] → [[Locate Professor Gai]] → [[Minions Gone Wild]] → [[Track Down Ang the Ephemeral]] → [[Shackled Spirits]] → [[An Audience with Master Togo (ritualist)|An Audience with Master Togo]]

:''Note: You can take all the secondary [[profession]] quests, this is highly recommended as you will gain much more experience. When you have already finished one of the eight secondary profession quest chains above, Master Togo will offer you an additional quest, which will effectively finalize your secondary profession choice.''

=== Kaineng City ===
:;8. [[Sunjiang District]]

:''After the completion of Sunjiang District, the players will find themselves in [[Maatu Keep]]. The storyline here forks in two different paths; the Kurzick one leads through the Echovald Forest, and the Luxon path takes the player to the Jade Sea. Note that these are '''not''' mutually exclusive, both can be completed, but only one is needed to continue the storyline. The storyline rejoins after the completion of the [[Unwaking Waters]] mission, with the quest [[Taking Back the Palace]].''
